title: Parrot Class
story: Chilaka wants to be an object: a parrot with a name that can learn words.
goal: Write class Parrot with __init__(self, name), teach(word) to remember a word and speak() returning the words joined by comma and space.
hints: In __init__ create self.name and an empty list self.words.
teach appends to self.words. speak joins them with ", ".join(...).
socratic: Which data does each parrot need of its own?
Why must the words list be created inside __init__?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Parrot Class”?
